subject: Implementation Conductor: MAP & post-signature sprint trajectory for Sceptor
messages:
From: Tim O'Rourke <tim@stargazer.ai>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine@stargazer.ai>
Date: 2027-01-30T09:12:00Z
Subject: Signed — next steps & MAP for rollout

Prio team,

Thanks — legal has returned the signed SOW (attached). We’re excited to get started. Per our internal plan, Sceptor's target go-live for the Redwood integration is 12 weeks from signature (target week of 2027-04-24).

High level asks from our side:
- A mutual action plan we can track against (milestones, owners, acceptance criteria).
- A canary window for 2 weeks during the final migration to validate traffic routing and KV cache behavior.
- A staged migration plan for the existing inference traffic (10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100%) with rollback gates.
- Training for two teams: Integrations (APIs + webhooks) and Ops (monitoring, incident runbooks).

Constraints:
- Data residency: US region only.
- SOC2 evidence will be needed by our compliance team during onboarding.
- We prefer a hybrid model where /generate endpoints run on Redwood Dedicated for peak batch inference, with fallback to Hosted during maintenance windows.

Attached: Sceptor-Signed-Agreement.pdf (signed). Can you send a draft MAP and a proposed kickoff date?

—Tim
Director of Platform
Sceptor HealthTech
[Attachment: Sceptor-Signed-Agreement.pdf (PDF)]

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Tim O'Rourke <tim@stargazer.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-30T11:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Signed — next steps & MAP for rollout

Tim — great to see this across the finish line, congrats to your team. We’ll own delivery on the Redwood side.

I’m attaching an initial MAP (Implementation Conductor draft) that embeds the canary and migration phases into a week-by-week sprint trajectory. High-level milestones included: kickoff, infra provisioning, model pin + quantization check, shadow canary, staged traffic ramp, training blitz, final cutover and acceptance.

Key proposals from our side:
- Kickoff: Wednesday 2027-02-02 (30–45m) to align owners and confirm acceptance criteria.
- Canary approach: 2-week live canary (shadow traffic first 48h, then 5% traffic ramps) with automatic rollback predicates on latency or error rate thresholds.
- Migration ramp: 10% weekly increases following successful canary gate reviews; we can compress to 3 days per step for accelerated customers if Sceptor prefers.
- Training: two 90-minute sessions per team + on-demand playbook; we’ll deliver runbooks and a recording.

We’ll also surface SOC2 artifacts and a compliance checklist during the provisioning sprint. If Sceptor needs a dedicated KMS/HSM integration, we’ll loop Security (that will add ~1 week to the provisioning window).

I’ve cc’d Karthik (engineering lead — runtime & canary tuning) and Laura (program manager — onboarding cadence). Karthik/Laura — can you confirm ownership on the infra checklist and whether a 12-week target is feasible with a single dedicated GPU pool?

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4782

Attachments: MAP-draft-implementation-conductor.xlsx

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP-draft-implementation-conductor.xlsx (Excel)]

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-30T14:35:00Z
Subject: Internal: Sceptor MAP — quick ops/engineering split of work

Folks — forwarding Tim's note for context. TL;DR: 12-week go-live, 2-week canary, staged ramp, training for Integrations + Ops.

Proposed internal split (please push back if overloaded):
- Karthik: runtime config (dedicated GPU pools sizing, kernel/quantization recommendation), canary predicates, automated rollback hooks, and the deployment playbook. Estimated effort: 2 weeks to finalize canary config + ongoing support during canary.
- Laura: program management (mutual action plan owner, weekly cadence, customer-facing acceptance signoffs, training scheduling). Estimated effort: PM + 1x engagement lead; run weekly checkpoints.
- Priyom: solution validation, run two customer training sessions, create runbooks and recordings, own SOC2 artifact handoff.

Engineering notes for Karthik:
- We’ll recommend continuous batching up to 64 tokens for the Integrations happy path; ensure KV cache sizing handles expected session concurrency (Elaine mentioned ~300 concurrent sessions peak).
- Plan for an autoscale burst policy for the Dedicated pool and a routing policy to fallback to Hosted API during slot pressure — need a fast fallback for <150ms additional tail latency.

Attachments: internal-runbook-checklist.md (draft).

Let me know if we should build an accelerated 8-week path (compress training + parallelize provisioning) — that would require 48–72h of operations overtime during cutover.

—Priyom
[Attachment: internal-runbook-checklist.md (Markdown)]

From: Tim O'Rourke <tim@stargazer.ai>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine@stargazer.ai>
Date: 2027-01-31T17:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Signed — next steps & MAP for rollout

Priyom / team — this looks good. We’re aligned to the proposed milestones and the 12-week trajectory. A few quick notes:
- Please include a short acceptance checklist for Integrations to validate model outputs against our baseline (we’ll share a holdout prompt set).
- SOC2 artifacts: Elaine will coordinate with your security liaison to get the evidence list next week.
- Kickoff: 2027-02-02 works for our engineering and product leads — send calendar invite.

I’ve initiated the DocuSign final order confirmations (link below) and Elaine will supply the holdout eval set by Friday.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/txn/ABC-123-DS

Thanks — looking forward to kickoff.

—Tim
Director of Platform
Sceptor HealthTech
